Exhaustive intervals cover all schedules; violated means violation for every schedule and every resolution of unknown mass. Simulation uses per-case Clopper-Pearson sums with cross-plan Bonferroni and hits plus unknown at the upper endpoint, not point estimates or a proof. Truncated and undetermined mass stays unknown.
